name: .338 Cal-128gr Stone Hammer®

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist is 1-19″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this bullet for a customer that was looking for a lighter pure copper bullet for the 338 Federal that would feed properly. This Stone Hammer® will run comfortably well over 3000 fps in the 338 Federal. Just think what it would do in your 338 Winchester Magnum."
